<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Montserrat:wght@700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
#ids-app{--ink:#0f0b07;--ink2:#1b140c;--ink3:#271d12;--line:rgba(217,182,90,.22);--gold:#d9b65a;--gold-hi:#f7e9a8;--gold-lo:#a47a35;--gold-grad:linear-gradient(100deg,#a47a35 0%,#d9b65a 30%,#f7e9a8 50%,#d9b65a 70%,#a47a35 100%);--cream:#fbf4e2;--cream2:#f1e6c8;--text:#fff;--muted:rgba(255,255,255,.74);--bad:#e57c6b;--cta-h:54px;--hf:"Montserrat",system-ui,sans-serif;--bf:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif}
html.ids-lock,html.ids-lock body{overflow:hidden!important;height:100%!important;overscroll-behavior:none}
#ids-app,#ids-app *{box-sizing:border-box}
#ids-app{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99990;background:var(--ink);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--bf);font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;overflow:clip}
/* hide the site's floating Click to Chat button while the story is open; keep its greetings form usable */
html.ids-lock #ht-ctc-chat>:not(.ht_ctc_greetings){display:none!important}
/* hide the site's "Content is protected" alert (WP Content Copy Protection) on this page */
html.ids-lock #wpcp-error-message,html.ids-lock .msgmsg-box-wpcp{display:none!important;visibility:hidden!important}
#ids-app img{-webkit-user-drag:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}
#ids-app .ids-slides,#ids-app .ids-top,#ids-app .ids-ctabar{-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none}
#ids-app h1,#ids-app h2,#ids-app h3,#ids-app p,#ids-app ul,#ids-app li,#ids-app table{margin:0;padding:0;font-family:inherit;letter-spacing:normal;text-transform:none;color:inherit}
#ids-app ul{list-style:none}
#ids-app img{max-width:none;border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none}
#ids-app button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;margin:0;padding:0;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:none;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:normal;line-height:inherit;min-height:0;border-radius:0}
#ids-app a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
#ids-app strong,#ids-app b{color:#fff;font-weight:700}

/* desktop blurred backdrop */
#ids-app .ids-backdrop{position:absolute;inset:-40px;background-size:cover;background-position:center;filter:blur(38px) brightness(.38) saturate(1.1);transition:background-image .5s}
/* story frame */
#ids-app .ids-frame{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;background:var(--ink);overflow:hidden;overflow:clip;container-type:size}
@media (min-width:640px){#ids-app .ids-frame{height:min(calc(100dvh - 32px),940px);width:auto;aspect-ratio:9/17.5;max-width:520px;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 0 1px rgba(217,182,90,.18)}}

/* progress + top bar */
#ids-app .ids-progress{position:absolute;top:calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-top));left:10px;right:10px;display:flex;gap:4px;z-index:30}
#ids-app .ids-progress i{flex:1;height:3px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.28);overflow:hidden;position:relative}
#ids-app .ids-progress i::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;width:0;background:var(--gold-hi);border-radius:3px;transition:width .45s ease}
#ids-app .ids-progress i.done::after{width:100%;background:var(--gold)}
#ids-app .ids-progress i.on::after{width:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-hi))}
#ids-app .ids-top{position:absolute;top:calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-top));left:12px;right:12px;height:38px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;z-index:30}
#ids-app .ids-back{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(0,0,0,.42);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);display:grid;place-items:center;transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
#ids-app .ids-back svg{width:16px;height:16px}
#ids-app .ids-back[hidden]{display:grid!important;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:scale(.7);width:0;margin-right:-10px}
#ids-app .ids-logo{height:24px;width:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.55))}
#ids-app .ids-skip{margin-left:auto;font-family:var(--hf);font-weight:800;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#1c1408;background:var(--gold-grad);background-size:200% 100%;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35);transition:opacity .25s;white-space:nowrap}
#ids-app .ids-skip[hidden]{display:block!important;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
#ids-app .ids-snd{margin-left:auto;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(0,0,0,.42);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);display:grid;place-items:center;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);position:relative}
#ids-app .ids-snd svg{width:17px;height:17px}
#ids-app .ids-snd .off{display:none}
#ids-app .ids-snd.muted .on{display:none}
#ids-app .ids-snd.muted .off{display:block}
#ids-app .ids-snd.playing{border-color:var(--gold)}
#ids-app .ids-snd.waiting::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-3px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--gold);opacity:0;animation:ids-snd 1.8s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes ids-snd{0%{opacity:.7;transform:scale(.9)}100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.25)}}
#ids-app .ids-snd+.ids-skip{margin-left:8px}

/* slides */
#ids-app .ids-slides{position:absolute;inset:0}
#ids-app .ids-slide{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateX(5%) scale(.985);transition:opacity .42s ease,transform .42s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),visibility 0s .42s}
#ids-app .ids-slide.is-on{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:none;transition:opacity .42s ease,transform .42s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),visibility 0s}
#ids-app .ids-slide.is-prev{transform:translateX(-5%) scale(.985)}
#ids-app .ids-media{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:var(--mh,58%);overflow:hidden;background:var(--ink2)}
#ids-app .ids-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:var(--mp,center 30%);display:block;transform:scale(1.06);transition:transform 7s ease-out}
#ids-app .ids-slide.is-on .ids-media img{transform:scale(1)}
#ids-app .ids-media::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;height:120px;background:linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,.55),transparent);z-index:1}
#ids-app .ids-media::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 42%,rgba(15,11,7,.72) 74%,var(--ink) 99%)}
#ids-app .ids-glow{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(120% 60% at 50% 0%,rgba(217,182,90,.18),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(90% 50% at 100% 100%,rgba(217,182,90,.08),transparent 70%)}
#ids-app .ids-body{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;max-height:100%;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;scrollbar-width:none;padding:0 20px calc(var(--cta-h) + 44px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));text-align:center}
#ids-app .ids-body::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
#ids-app .ids-slide[data-layout="top"] .ids-body{top:0;padding-top:calc(78px + env(safe-area-inset-top));display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
#ids-app .ids-slide[data-layout="top"] .ids-body>.ids-inner{margin:auto 0}

/* typography */
#ids-app .ids-kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-family:var(--hf);font-weight:800;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-hi);border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(15,11,7,.55);padding:6px 11px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:12px;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
#ids-app .ids-h{font-family:var(--hf);font-weight:900;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:29px;font-size:clamp(23px,7.6cqw,36px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.01em;text-wrap:balance}
#ids-app .ids-h span{display:block}
#ids-app .ids-h .g{background:var(--gold-grad);background-size:220% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;animation:ids-sheen 6s linear infinite}
@keyframes ids-sheen{0%{background-position:0% 0}100%{background-position:220% 0}}
#ids-app .ids-sub{font-family:var(--hf);font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);font-size:15px;margin-top:8px}
#ids-app .ids-p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14.5px;font-size:clamp(13.5px,3.75cqw,15.5px);line-height:1.55;margin-top:12px}
#ids-app .ids-p+.ids-p{margin-top:9px}
#ids-app .ids-note{color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.45;margin-top:12px}

/* byline + rating (hook) */
#ids-app .ids-byline{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin-top:16px}
#ids-app .ids-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:#000 center/78% no-repeat;border:1.5px solid var(--gold);flex:none}
#ids-app .ids-byline div{text-align:left;font-size:12px;line-height:1.35;color:var(--muted)}
#ids-app .ids-byline b{display:block;font-size:12.5px}
#ids-app .ids-rating{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;margin-top:10px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
#ids-app .ids-stars{color:var(--gold-hi);letter-spacing:1px;font-size:13px}

/* feature list */
#ids-app .ids-feats{margin-top:14px;text-align:left;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
#ids-app .ids-feats li{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:11px 2px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--muted)}
#ids-app .ids-ic{flex:none;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(217,182,90,.08);color:var(--gold-hi)}
#ids-app .ids-ic svg{width:18px;height:18px}
#ids-app .ids-feats b{display:inline}

/* sign list (problem) */
#ids-app .ids-signs{margin:14px auto 0;max-width:330px;text-align:left}
#ids-app .ids-signs li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:7px 0;font-size:14px;color:#fff;font-weight:500}
#ids-app .ids-x{flex:none;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(229,124,107,.16);color:var(--bad)}
#ids-app .ids-ok{flex:none;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(217,182,90,.18);color:var(--gold-hi)}
#ids-app .ids-x svg,#ids-app .ids-ok svg{width:12px;height:12px}

/* compare */
#ids-app .ids-toggle{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;border:1.5px solid var(--cream2);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;margin:16px auto 0;max-width:360px}
#ids-app .ids-toggle button{font-family:var(--hf);font-weight:800;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:11px 6px;color:var(--cream);transition:background .3s,color .3s}
#ids-app .ids-toggle button.on{background:var(--cream);color:#1c1408}
#ids-app .ids-teeth{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin:18px 0 6px}
#ids-app .ids-teeth svg{width:34px;height:34px;transition:color .35s,transform .35s,opacity .35s}
#ids-app .ids-cmp[data-v="a"] .ids-teeth svg{color:var(--bad);opacity:.9}
#ids-app .ids-cmp[data-v="b"] .ids-teeth svg{color:var(--gold-hi);transform:translateY(-2px)}
#ids-app .ids-price{font-family:var(--hf);font-weight:900;font-size:46px;font-size:clamp(38px,12cqw,54px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em}
#ids-app .ids-cmp[data-v="a"] .ids-price{color:var(--bad)}
#ids-app .ids-cmp[data-v="b"] .ids-price{background:var(--gold-grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
#ids-app .ids-price small{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0;margin-left:4px;color:#fff;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff}
#ids-app .ids-price-sub{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}
#ids-app .ids-cmp-list{margin:14px auto 0;max-width:340px;text-align:left;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
#ids-app .ids-cmp-list li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:10px 2px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
#ids-app .ids-cmp-list li b{margin-right:3px}
#ids-app .ids-cmp [data-show]{display:none}
#ids-app .ids-cmp[data-v="a"] [data-show="a"],#ids-app .ids-cmp[data-v="b"] [data-show="b"]{display:revert}
#ids-app .ids-cmp[data-v="a"] li[data-show="a"],#ids-app .ids-cmp[data-v="b"] li[data-show="b"]{display:flex}
#ids-app .ids-cmp .ids-swap{animation:ids-pop .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.3)}
@keyframes ids-pop{0%{transform:scale(.86);opacity:.2}100%{transform:none;opacity:1}}

/* real before/after */
#ids-app .ids-ba-tabs{margin-top:14px}
#ids-app .ids-ba-frame{position:relative;margin:14px auto 0;width:min(100%,44cqh);aspect-ratio:1/1;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;border:1.5px solid var(--gold);box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5);background:var(--ink2)}
#ids-app .ids-ba-frame img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;opacity:0;transition:opacity .45s}
#ids-app .ids-ba-frame img.on{opacity:1}
#ids-app .ids-ba-cap[hidden]{display:none}

/* stepper */
#ids-app .ids-track{position:relative;margin:18px 6px 4px;height:30px}
#ids-app .ids-track::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:8px;right:8px;top:50%;height:3px;margin-top:-1.5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:3px}
#ids-app .ids-track-fill{position:absolute;left:8px;top:50%;height:3px;margin-top:-1.5px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold-lo),var(--gold-hi));border-radius:3px;width:0;transition:width .5s ease}
#ids-app .ids-dots{position:absolute;inset:0 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
#ids-app .ids-dots button{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink3);border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);transition:background .3s,border-color .3s;position:relative}
#ids-app .ids-dots button.done{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold)}
#ids-app .ids-dots button::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-10px}
#ids-app .ids-marker{position:absolute;top:50%;width:30px;height:30px;margin:-15px 0 0 -15px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold-grad);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#1c1408;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(217,182,90,.22),0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.4);transition:left .5s cubic-bezier(.3,.9,.3,1.1);pointer-events:none}
#ids-app .ids-marker svg{width:16px;height:16px}
#ids-app .ids-track-labels{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-family:var(--hf);font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 12px}
#ids-app .ids-cards{position:relative;height:118px}
#ids-app .ids-card{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;text-align:left;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--cream);color:#1c1408;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35);transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),opacity .45s;opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px) scale(.94)}
#ids-app .ids-card.on{opacity:1;transform:none;z-index:2}
#ids-app .ids-card.next{opacity:.35;transform:translateY(64px) scale(.92);z-index:1}
#ids-app .ids-card .n{flex:none;width:58px;text-align:center;font-family:var(--hf);font-weight:900;font-size:38px;line-height:1;color:var(--gold-lo)}
#ids-app .ids-card .n small{display:block;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#6b5a3a;margin-top:4px}
#ids-app .ids-card h3{font-family:var(--hf);font-weight:900;font-size:15px;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.15;color:#1c1408}
#ids-app .ids-card p{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.45;color:#4a3d27;margin-top:4px}

/* 2x2 grid */
#ids-app .ids-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:16px;text-align:left}
#ids-app .ids-grid li{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;color:#fff;font-weight:500;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}

/* report card table */
#ids-app .ids-table{width:100%;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0 4px;margin-top:14px;font-size:12px;table-layout:fixed}
#ids-app .ids-table th{font-family:var(--hf);font-weight:800;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#1c1408;background:var(--gold);padding:8px 8px;text-align:left}
#ids-app .ids-table th:first-child{border-radius:6px 0 0 6px;width:30%}
#ids-app .ids-table th:last-child{border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;width:20%;text-align:center}
#ids-app .ids-table td{background:var(--cream);color:#2a2113;padding:9px 8px;line-height:1.3;vertical-align:middle;text-align:left}
#ids-app .ids-table td:first-child{font-family:var(--hf);font-weight:800;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:6px 0 0 6px}
#ids-app .ids-table td:last-child{border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;text-align:center;background:var(--gold-grad);color:#1c1408;font-family:var(--hf);font-weight:900;font-size:16px}
#ids-app .ids-table tr.total td{background:transparent;color:#fff;font-family:var(--hf);font-weight:900;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
#ids-app .ids-table tr.total td:last-child{background:var(--gold-grad);color:#1c1408;font-size:16px}

/* reviews */
#ids-app .ids-revs{margin-top:14px;position:relative}
#ids-app .ids-rev-vp{overflow:hidden;border-radius:14px}
#ids-app .ids-rev-row{display:flex;transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
#ids-app .ids-rev{flex:0 0 100%;background:var(--cream);color:#2a2113;border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px 16px;text-align:left}
#ids-app .ids-rev-h{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px}
#ids-app .ids-rev-av{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold-grad);display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--hf);font-weight:900;font-size:12px;color:#1c1408;flex:none}
#ids-app .ids-rev-h b{display:block;color:#1c1408;font-size:13.5px}
#ids-app .ids-rev-h span{font-size:11px;color:#7a6847}
#ids-app .ids-rev-h .ids-stars{color:#c99a2e;font-size:11px;margin-right:4px}
#ids-app .ids-rev q{display:block;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.5;quotes:"\201C" "\201D"}
#ids-app .ids-rev-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin-top:12px}
#ids-app .ids-rev-nav>button{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);display:grid;place-items:center}
#ids-app .ids-rev-nav>button svg{width:14px;height:14px}
#ids-app .ids-rev-dots{display:flex;gap:6px}
#ids-app .ids-rev-dots i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.35);transition:width .3s,background .3s}
#ids-app .ids-rev-dots i.on{width:18px;background:var(--gold)}

/* tiers */
#ids-app .ids-tiers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:20px}
#ids-app .ids-tier{position:relative;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:12px;padding:20px 6px 12px;text-align:center;transition:background .25s,border-color .25s,transform .25s;color:#fff}
#ids-app .ids-tier.on{background:var(--cream);border-color:var(--gold);color:#1c1408;transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
#ids-app .ids-tier .bdg{position:absolute;top:-9px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap;font-family:var(--hf);font-weight:900;font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--gold-grad);color:#1c1408}
#ids-app .ids-tier .bdg.alt{background:#e9dcc0}
#ids-app .ids-tier .ti{width:26px;height:26px;margin:0 auto 6px;color:var(--gold)}
#ids-app .ids-tier.on .ti{color:var(--gold-lo)}
#ids-app .ids-tier .nm{display:block;font-family:var(--hf);font-weight:800;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.2;min-height:24px}
#ids-app .ids-tier .pr{display:block;font-family:var(--hf);font-weight:900;font-size:19px;line-height:1.1;margin-top:4px}
#ids-app .ids-tier .pr small{font-size:10px;font-weight:700}
#ids-app .ids-tier s{display:block;font-size:11px;opacity:.6;margin-top:2px;min-height:15px}
#ids-app .ids-tier-desc{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:12px;min-height:38px}

  $$('.ids-revs').forEach(function(rv){var s=rv.closest('.ids-slide'),n=$$('.ids-rev',rv).length,dw=rv.querySelector('.ids-rev-dots');for(var j=0;j<n;j++)dw.appendChild(document.createElement('i'));
    function cur(){return +rv.querySelector('.ids-rev-row').getAttribute('data-k')||0;}
    rv.querySelector('.ids-rev-prev').addEventListener('click',function(){clearTimers();revTo(s,(cur()-1+n)%n);});
    rv.querySelector('.ids-rev-next').addEventListener('click',function(){clearTimers();revTo(s,(cur()+1)%n);});
    var rx=null;rv.addEventListener('touchstart',function(e){rx=e.touches[0].clientX;},{passive:true});
    rv.addEventListener('touchend',function(e){if(rx===null)return;var dx=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-rx;if(Math.abs(dx)>40){clearTimers();revTo(s,(cur()+(dx<0?1:-1)+n)%n);}rx=null;},{passive:true});
    revTo(s,0);});

  // tiers
  var desc=$('.ids-tier-desc');
  $$('.ids-tier').forEach(function(t){t.addEventListener('click',function(){$$('.ids-tier').forEach(function(o){o.classList.toggle('on',o===t);o.setAttribute('aria-checked',o===t?'true':'false');});desc.innerHTML=t.getAttribute('data-desc');pkg={id:t.getAttribute('data-pkg'),label:t.getAttribute('data-label')};track('story_pick',{story_package:pkg.id});});});

  // booking sheet
  var sheet=$('.ids-sheet'), host=$('#ids-form-host'), wa=$('.ids-wa'), moved=false;
  var match={pkg4:/year\s*end/i,assess:/assess/i,braces:/^\s*braces\s*$/i};
  var gmatch={pkg4:/scal+ing/i,braces:/^\s*braces\s*$/i}; // Click to Chat greetings form has no 'Year End' option
  function attachForm(){
    if(moved) return true;
    var src=document.getElementById('ids-form-src'); if(!src) return false;
    host.innerHTML=''; host.appendChild(src); src.style.display='block'; moved=true; return true;
  }
  function preselect(){
    var sel=host.querySelector('select'); if(!sel) return;
    for(var i=0;i<sel.options.length;i++){ if(match[pkg.id]&&match[pkg.id].test(sel.options[i].text)){ sel.selectedIndex=i; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); if(window.jQuery){try{window.jQuery(sel).trigger('change');}catch(e){}} break; } }
  }
  function openSheet(){
    attachForm(); preselect();
    $('.ids-pick-t').textContent=pkg.label;
    var msg='Hi Infinity Dental, saya nak tempah slot untuk '+pkg.label+'. (Dari promo Year End Smile Care)';
    waUrl='https://wa.me/'+app.getAttribute('data-wa')+'?text='+encodeURIComponent(msg);
    if(hasCtc()){ try{ if(window.ht_ctc_chat_var) window.ht_ctc_chat_var.pre_filled=msg; }catch(e){} }
    sheet.classList.add('open'); sheet.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false'); music.duck(true);
    track('story_book_open',{story_package:pkg.id});
  }
  function closeSheet(){sheet.classList.remove('open');sheet.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');music.duck(false);}
  $('.ids-close').addEventListener('click',closeSheet);
  $('.ids-sheet-bg').addEventListener('click',closeSheet);
  // WhatsApp: use the site's Click to Chat greetings form when present (keeps the CRM/tracking flow), else plain wa.me
  // (checked at click time: the plugin renders in the footer, after this script)
  var waUrl='https://wa.me/'+app.getAttribute('data-wa');
  function hasCtc(){return !!document.querySelector('#ht-ctc-chat .ht_ctc_chat_greetings_box');}
  wa.addEventListener('click',function(e){track('story_whatsapp',{story_package:pkg.id});
    if(hasCtc()){ setTimeout(closeSheet,60); setTimeout(function(){ var g=document.querySelector('#ht-ctc-chat select'); if(!g) return; for(var i=0;i<g.options.length;i++){ if(gmatch[pkg.id]&&gmatch[pkg.id].test(g.options[i].text)){ g.selectedIndex=i; g.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); break; } } },300); }
    else { e.preventDefault(); window.open(waUrl,'_blank','noopener'); }});
  if(window.jQuery){try{window.jQuery(document).on('fluentform_submission_success',function(){track('story_form_submit',{story_package:pkg.id});});}catch(e){}}

  // background music: tries to play as soon as the page loads. Where the browser blocks sound until the
  // visitor interacts (most mobile browsers), it starts on the very first touch/click/key anywhere on the page.
  var music=(function(){
    var url=app.getAttribute('data-music'), btn=$('.ids-snd'), VOL=0.42, DUCK=0.14;
    var on=true, ducked=false, ctx=null, gain=null, el=null, loading=false, ready=false, unlockedAt=0;
    try{ if(localStorage.getItem('ids_music')==='off') on=false; }catch(e){}
    try{ if(navigator.audioSession) navigator.audioSession.type='playback'; }catch(e){} // iOS 17+: audible even with the silent switch on
    var evs=['pointerdown','pointerup','touchend','click','keydown'];
    function playing(){ return on && ((ctx && ready && ctx.state==='running') || (el && !el.paused)); }
    function ui(){ var pl=playing();
      btn.classList.toggle('muted',!on); btn.classList.toggle('playing',pl); btn.classList.toggle('waiting',on&&!pl);
      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed',on?'true':'false'); btn.setAttribute('aria-label',on?(pl?'Matikan muzik':'Mainkan muzik'):'Hidupkan muzik');
      if(pl) evs.forEach(function(t){ document.removeEventListener(t,unlock,true); }); }
    function target(){ return on ? (ducked?DUCK:VOL) : 0; }
    function ramp(sec){ var v=target();
      if(gain&&ctx){ var t=ctx.currentTime; gain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(t); gain.gain.setValueAtTime(gain.gain.value,t); gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v,t+(sec||0.6)); }
      else if(el){ el.volume=v; } }
    function resume(){ if(!on) return;
      if(ctx&&ctx.state!=='running'&&ctx.resume){ var p=ctx.resume(); if(p&&p.then) p.then(ui,function(){}); }
      if(el&&el.paused){ var q=el.play(); if(q&&q.then) q.then(ui,function(){}); } }
    function load(){
      if(!url||loading) return; loading=true;
      var AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;
      if(AC){ try{
        ctx=new AC(); gain=ctx.createGain(); gain.gain.value=0; gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        ctx.onstatechange=function(){ if(ctx&&ctx.state==='running'&&ready) ramp(1.5); ui(); };
        fetch(url,{credentials:'omit'}).then(function(r){return r.arrayBuffer();}).then(function(b){return new Promise(function(res,rej){ctx.decodeAudioData(b,res,rej);});})
          .then(function(buf){ var src=ctx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer=buf; src.loop=true; src.connect(gain); src.start(0); ready=true; resume(); if(ctx.state==='running') ramp(1.5); ui(); })
          .catch(function(){ ctx=null; gain=null; html5(); });
        resume(); return; }catch(e){ ctx=null; gain=null; } }
      html5();
    }
    function html5(){ try{ el=new Audio(url); el.loop=true; el.preload='auto'; el.volume=target(); el.addEventListener('playing',ui); el.addEventListener('pause',ui); resume(); }catch(e){} ui(); }
    function unlock(){ if(!on) return; if(!playing()) unlockedAt=Date.now(); if(!loading) load(); resume(); ui(); }
    evs.forEach(function(t){ document.addEventListener(t,unlock,true); });
    function toggle(){
      on=!on; try{ localStorage.setItem('ids_music',on?'on':'off'); }catch(e){}
      if(on){ if(!loading) load(); resume(); ramp(0.8); }
      else { ramp(0.3); setTimeout(function(){ if(!on){ if(ctx&&ctx.suspend) ctx.suspend(); if(el) el.pause(); ui(); } },350); }
      ui(); track('story_sound',{story_sound:on?'on':'off'});
    }
    btn.addEventListener('click',function(e){ e.stopPropagation();
      if(on && Date.now()-unlockedAt<900) return; // this tap just started the music, don't mute it
      toggle(); });
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){ if(!on||!loading) return;
      if(document.hidden){ if(ctx&&ctx.suspend) ctx.suspend(); if(el) el.pause(); } else resume(); });
    if(on) load(); // autoplay attempt right away
    ui();
    return { duck:function(d){ ducked=d; if(loading) ramp(0.5); } };
  })();

  // long-press / right-click / drag inside the story: no menu, and don't let the copy-protection plugin react
  ['contextmenu','dragstart','selectstart'].forEach(function(t){ app.addEventListener(t,function(e){ if(e.target.closest('input,textarea,select,[contenteditable]')) return; e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }); });

  // start
  attachForm();
  go(/#promo|#offer/i.test(location.hash)?N-1:0);
})();
</script>
